from sympy import symbols, Eq, solve
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = symbols('x')
root = solve(Eq(3*x + 11, 14), x)[0]
print(f"x = {root}")

xs = [float(root) - 2, float(root) - 1, float(root), float(root) + 1, float(root) + 2]
ys = [3 * v + 11 for v in xs]
plt.plot(xs, ys, marker="o")
plt.axhline(14, linestyle="--", color="gray")
plt.axvline(float(root), linestyle="--", color="gray")
plt.title("3x + 11 = 14")
plt.savefig("solution.png")
